nsRecords.closeComment:
Thanks for your interest in is-a.dev!

This pull request requests `NS` records. We do not grant nameserver records to first-time contributors, so I am closing this pull request.

You are welcome to open a new pull request using other record types, such as `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX` or `TXT`. Once you have an accepted registration, you can request `NS` records with a clear justification for why they are needed.

Please see the [Docs](https://docs.is-a.dev/faq/#who-can-use-ns-records) for more information.
